title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Public Health Administration
description: This course teaches learners the skills and knowledge to lead and manage public health programs.
longDescription: The Professional Certificate Course in Introduction to Public Health Administration provides an overview of the foundational concepts of public health. Students will learn how the World Trade Organization and the importance of prevention in public health define health. The course also covers the determinants of health, the evolution of public health, and the functions of public health agencies in the 21st century.
courseDetails: The Professional Certificate Course in Introduction to Public Health Administration covers foundational concepts, including the definition of health by the World Trade Organization and the importance of prevention.
